as_of_content:
[[File:Stable Nucleon Core portrait.png|thumb]]
==Description==
''An incredibly powerful energy source capable of granting great strength to non-organic life. Nucleon must be kept stable at all times, mishandling of the substance can have disastrous consequences.''

==Relic Boosts ==
*+5% Attack and Health in all game modes.
==Obtainment==
This Relic can be earned upon completing the [[Revenge of the King]] Special Mission.
==Gallery==
<gallery>
File:Stable Nucleon Core icon.jpg
</gallery>

== Notes ==

* The Stable Nucleon Core is called the '''Stasis Generator''' in the game files.
